verdict.rationale: Plaid documents verifying ID documents along with name, date of birth, ID numbers and addresses, and it exposes an Identity Verification API (e.g. /identity_verification/retry) plus STATUS_UPDATED webhooks. However, nothing in the evidence shows the extracted document fields coming back as structured data from an API call; the session detail described is Dashboard-centric. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint/response returning extracted document fields (name, DOB, document number, address, expiry), expiry-date extraction, response schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
